Title: The Nutrition Source
Description: Evidence-based guidance on food and health from the Department of Nutrition at the Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health.
Author: Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health

Title: Food Politics
Description: Marion Nestle's long-running blog on food policy and food-industry marketing and how they shape nutrition research and advice.
Author: Marion Nestle

Title: Stronger by Science
Description: In-depth reviews of research on strength training and muscle growth and the nutrition that supports them.
Author: Greg Nuckols

Title: Precision Nutrition
Description: Articles on eating habits and body composition and on coaching people to change them from a nutrition coaching and certification company.
Author: Precision Nutrition

Title: NutritionFacts.org
Description: Nonprofit site founded by physician Michael Greger that summarizes nutrition studies from a whole-food plant-based perspective.
Author: Michael Greger

Title: Minimalist Baker
Description: Plant-based recipes designed to need few ingredients or one bowl or about 30 minutes.
Author: Dana Shultz

Title: Love and Lemons
Description: Vegetarian recipes built around seasonal vegetables and fruit for weeknight dinners and salads and soups.
Author: Jeanine Donofrio
